hypotheses.G0_all_channels_recompose_exactly: All 192 native bilinear channel operators reconstruct the complete Layer-0 Jacobian above 0.9999 fidelity.
hypotheses.G1_pure_rule_has_a_compact_native_bank: Discovery-fixed top-32 channels retain at least 0.80 fidelity in both pure-rule seeds.
hypotheses.G2_mixed_top32_is_insufficient: Discovery-fixed top-32 channels retain at most 0.60 fidelity in both mixed seeds.
hypotheses.G3_mixed_top128_is_sufficient: Discovery-fixed top-128 channels retain at least 0.80 fidelity in both mixed seeds.
hypotheses.G4_native_ranking_beats_random_channels: Top-32 fidelity exceeds the 95th percentile of matched random-32 subsets by at least 0.10 in every run.
hypotheses.G5_mixed_bank_is_globally_reusable: Per-site top-32 selection improves over the discovery-fixed top-32 bank by at most 0.10 in both mixed seeds.
hypotheses.G6_top_channels_are_necessary: Removing the discovery-fixed top-32 channels loses at least 0.10 fidelity relative to the complete chart in every run.
